mapper.sql: select a.id, a.task_type, a.task_status, a.tray_id, a.tray_code, a.location_id, a.`result` , a.task_no, a.purpose_position, a.start_position, a.receive_time, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.error_code, a.error_message, a.current_line_number, a.request_count, a.send_data, a.accept_data, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag , a.delivery_type from t_task_wcs a
mapper.delete: update t_task_wcs set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_task_wcs set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select a.id , a.task_status , b.task_id, b.`type` as taskType, b.origin_id from t_task_wcs a left join t_task_wcs_detail b on a.id = b.task_id where a.tray_id = #{trayId} and b.`type` = #{taskType} and a.task_status in ('1','2','4')

select sd.dept_name deptName, sd.create_by createBy, sd.create_time createTime, ifnull(sm.library_count,0) libraryCount, count(case tw.task_type when '1' then 1 else null end) inTaskCount, count(case tw.task_type when '2' then 1 else null end) outTaskCount, count(case tw.task_type when '3' then 1 else null end) inventoryTaskCount from sys_dept sd left join (select sum(ifnull(library_count,0)) library_count,dept_id from t_stock_main where del_flag='0' group by dept_id) sm on sm.dept_id=sd.dept_id left join t_task_wcs tw on tw.dept_id=sd.dept_id and tw.del_flag='0' and tw.task_type in('1','2','3') where sd.del_flag='0' and sd.dept_id=#{deptId} group by sd.dept_id,sm.library_count order by sd.create_time desc

select t.*, m.code materialCode, m.name materialName from (select tw.task_no taskNo, tw.id id, l.name locationName, r.name reservoirName, tw.task_status taskStatus, tw.task_type taskType, (case tw.task_status when '1' then null else tw.create_by end) createBy, (case tw.task_status when '1' then null else tw.create_time end) createTime, (case twd.type when '1' then ti.material_id when '2' then tto.material_id when '5' then td.material_id else null end) materialId, (case twd.type when '1' then ti.predict_count when '2' then tto.predict_count when '5' then td.predict_count else null end) predictCount, (case twd.type when '1' then ti.actual_count when '2' then tto.actual_count when '5' then td.actual_count else null end) actualCount, (case twd.type when '1' then ti.batch_code else null end) batchCode from t_task_wcs tw left join t_task_wcs_detail twd on twd.task_id=tw.id left join t_task_in ti on ti.id=twd.origin_id left join t_task_out tto on tto.id=twd.origin_id left join t_task_detail td on td.id=twd.origin_id left join t_location l on l.id=tw.location_id left join t_reservoir r on r.id=l.reservoir_id
inner join sys_user u on u.user_name = tw.create_by and u.status = '0' inner join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.status = '0'
${params.dataScope} where tw.del_flag='0'
and tw.task_no like concat('%',#{taskNo},'%')
and tw.task_status =#{taskStatus} ) t left join t_material m on m.id=t.materialId where 1=1
and m.name like concat('%',#{materialName},'%')
order by t.id desc

select l.name locationName, tw.task_status taskStatus, tw.task_type taskType, tw.create_time createTime, tw.tray_code trayCode from t_task_wcs tw left join t_location l on l.id=tw.location_id where tw.del_flag='0' order by tw.id desc

select t1.notCompleteCount, t2.underwayCount, t3.hasCompleteCount from (select count(1) notCompleteCount from t_task_wcs where del_flag='0' and task_status='1' and task_type=#{taskType}) t1, (select count(1) underwayCount from t_task_wcs where del_flag='0' and task_status='2' and task_type=#{taskType}) t2, (select count(1) hasCompleteCount from t_task_wcs where del_flag='0' and task_status='3' and task_type=#{taskType}) t3

SELECT a.id, a.task_type, a.tray_id, a.tray_code, a.location_id, a.task_no, b.`code` as locationCode, b.floor_type, b.location_plies, b.pallet_node_id FROM t_task_wcs a LEFT JOIN t_location b ON a.location_id = b.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.task_status IN ('1','2') AND a.tray_code = #{trayCode} and a.task_type = #{taskType} order by a.id desc limit 1

SELECT a.id, a.task_type, a.tray_id, a.tray_code, a.location_id, a.task_no, a.purpose_position , a.start_position , b.`code` as locationCode, b.floor_type, b.location_plies, b.pallet_node_id, b.extention_type FROM t_task_wcs a LEFT JOIN t_location b ON a.location_id = b.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.task_no = #{taskNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update t_task_wcs set task_status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select a.id, a.task_type, a.task_status, a.tray_id, a.tray_code, a.location_id, a.task_no, a.main_task_no, a.purpose_position, a.start_position, a.delivery_type, a.priority from t_task_wcs a inner join t_location tl on a.location_id = tl.id where a.del_flag = '0' and tl.del_flag = '0' and a.task_type = '5' and a.task_status = '3' and a.tray_code = #{trayCode} and tl.pallet_node_id = #{tempPallet} order by a.create_time desc limit 1
select count(1) from t_task_wcs a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.task_type != '1' and a.task_type != '4' and a.task_status != '3'
